verdict.rationale: Zamzar offers a documented REST API with API-key Bearer/Basic auth, a jobs endpoint, an official Java SDK and a separate sandbox test endpoint. Together these let conversions run non-interactively from scripts or pipelines without the browser UI. Missing for 10: a CLI tool or CI-specific integrations/examples (e.g. a GitHub Action), machine-readable API specs (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use HTTP Bearer authentication (passing your API key as the bearer token)
To convert a file with Zamzar, you need to send a request to the `jobs` endpoint.
Use our official Java SDK for convenient access to all features of the API.
All example requests are made to `https://sandbox.zamzar.com/`.
